newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Forty killed in Mozambique bus crash - radio.
newsitem.headline: Forty killed in Mozambique bus crash - radio.

text.p: At least 40 people died and dozens were injured in a head-on collision between two buses in southern Mozambique, state radio reported on Wednesday.
The vehicles, one a minibus, collided on Tuesday on the country's main north-south highway, about 80 km (50 miles) north of Maputo.
The radio said the cause of the crash was not yet known.
Seven people were killed and around 50 were hurt in a crash on the same stretch of road a week ago.
